outcome: major obstetric complications (premature birth, hypertensive disorders, gestational pyelonephritis)
adverse pregnancy results (premature birth, perinatal mortality)
cohort: The study included 265 pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19 who were hospitalized at maternity facilities in Osh, Kyrgyzstan.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy does not automatically lead to severe illness but elevates the chances of specific pregnancy complications such as premature birth, hypertensive disorders, and gestational pyelonephritis, with a minor increase in premature birth rates and rare instances of perinatal mortality, particularly in severe maternal illness.
